source_claim: AlphaEvolve's evolutionary database balances exploration and exploitation while maintaining diversity across the search space
claim_boundary: This boundary records that LibreEvolve manifests include local sampling counts from runtime.history.sampling_balance_report: configured explore ratio, parent and inspiration strategy counts, per-generation decision counts, sampled candidate metadata, strategy-source counts, and metric/frontier/lineage indicators. It does not claim calibrated exploration/exploitation balance, fallback source-pool provenance, selected-program repetition tables, island/cell/metric/lineage/descriptor coverage, score-improvement versus diversity effects, equal-budget strategy comparisons, or an AlphaEvolve-grade database-balance policy.
